name: walk-wildlife-journal-vienna
description: A mobile-first, local-first walking journal that introduces historic places as a person moves through Vienna, VA or a Norfolk, VA prototype layer. It includes walk recording, geofenced historic prompts, personal reflections, geotagged nature observations, and a local points profile. The default experience has no account, server, analytics, or paid backend.

scripts.build:regions: npm run build:region norfolk && npm run build:region new-york-city && npm run build:region vienna
